description: Election Commission - Do here by declare that K. G. Nandasena was Selected as the member of the Embilipitiya Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of the Embilipitiya Pradeshiya Sabha (a local authority) due to a resignation. The content details the process under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, including the nomination by a political party secretary and the official declaration by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under electoral processes and the administration of local government elections, making it a Type 7 (Elections) classification.
